## Data Preparation


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
library(easystats)
library(patchwork)
library(ggside)
library(ggdist)
library(brms)
library(cogmod)

options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores() - 2)

df <- read.csv("../data/data_participants.csv")
dftask <- read.csv("../data/data_task.csv") |>
  merge(read.csv("../data/data_eyetracking.csv"), all.x = TRUE) |>
  mutate(Condition = fct_relevel(Condition, "Human Original", "Human Forgery", "AI-Generated"),
         Emotion = fct_relevel(Emotion, "Positive - Low intensity", "Negative - Low intensity", "Positive - High intensity", "Negative - High intensity"),
         Meaning = Meaning * 6,
         Valence = Valence * 6 + 1,
         Worth = factor(Worth * 6, ordered = TRUE),
         SelfRelevance = SelfRelevance * 6)
levels(dftask$Worth) <- c("0", "10", "100", "1000", "10000", "100000")

cols <- c(
  # Condition
  "Human Original" = "#F51D56",
  "Human Forgery" = "#F5A41D",
  "AI-Generated" = "#1D9AF5",
  "AI Original" = "#1D9AF5",
  "AI Copy" = "#4CAF50",
  "Not recognized" = "#607D8B")
```
:::


## How to read this report

Every model below is a Bayesian mixed model (`brms` + `cogmod`) of one outcome
on `Condition * Emotion`, where **Condition** is the label shown before the
artwork (Human Original, Human Forgery, AI-Generated; all artworks were in fact
human originals) and **Emotion** is the stimulus's normative valence x arousal
quadrant. Random effects: `(Condition * Emotion | Participant)` and
`(Condition | Item)`.

Each model section has, in this order: (1) the model-implied distributions
(figures), (2) a **convergence** table, (3) **marginal means** per condition on
the response scale, (4) **all contrasts** between label conditions, for every
distributional parameter, as a coloured table (green = credibly positive,
red = credibly negative, grey = 95% CI includes 0), (5) the same contrasts
within each emotion quadrant, and (6) an **auto-generated summary** of the
credible effects. Every table also exists as a folded Markdown table
("for text readers"); those, and the pooled CSVs written by the Summary
section (`data/results_contrasts.csv`, `data/results_means.csv`), are the
machine-readable outputs.

Contrasts are differences of posterior medians (`Level1 - Level2`) with a 95%
credible interval and the probability of direction (`pd`). "Credible" below
means the CI excludes 0; no multiplicity correction is applied.

**Units.** To keep outcomes comparable, every difference that lives on a
bounded scale is reported in **percent of that scale's range**: the 0-1
sliders and gaze proportions, the CHOCO probabilities (`mu`, `confright`,
`confleft`, `pex`, `bex`, `pmid`), the hurdle probability `pzero`, the `zoi` /
`coi` inflation probabilities, and the per-category probabilities of the
ordinal models are multiplied by 100; the Valence (1-7) and Meaning (0-6)
response-scale differences are divided by their range (6) and multiplied by
100. Parameters without a bounded scale (`phi`, `precright`, `precleft`,
`sigma`, `disc`, `Gaze_Shift` in stimulus widths) stay on their own scale and
are marked `raw` in the tables. The CSVs carry both the raw and the percent
columns.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code  code-summary="Reporting helpers (tables, diagnostics, generated summaries)"}
# Compatibility shims -------------------------------------------------------
# The models in models/ were fitted in July 2026 with cogmod < 0.3, whose
# custom families were named "choco" and "betadiscrete". brms resolves the
# post-processing methods of a custom family by name (posterior_epred_<name>,
# posterior_predict_<name>, log_lik_<name>) in the family's environment, which
# is the global environment for these fits. cogmod 0.3 renamed the families to
# cogmod_choco / cogmod_betadiscrete (same parameters, same density), so alias
# the new methods under the old names until the models are refitted with the
# new API (analysis/server/). Remove this block after the refit.
for (fam in c("choco", "betadiscrete")) {
  for (fun in c("posterior_epred", "posterior_predict", "log_lik")) {
    old <- paste0(fun, "_", fam)
    new <- paste0(fun, "_cogmod_", fam)
    if (!exists(old, envir = globalenv(), inherits = FALSE) &&
        exists(new, envir = asNamespace("cogmod"))) {
      assign(old, get(new, envir = asNamespace("cogmod")), envir = globalenv())
    }
  }
}
if (!exists("dchoco")) dchoco <- cogmod::dcogmod_choco # used by get_marginal_densities()

# Reporting helpers: every model section calls fa_report(), which prints
#   1. a convergence table (chains, draws, Rhat, ESS, divergences)
#   2. marginal means per Condition on the response scale
#   3. the full contrast table (every parameter, credible or not), as a coloured
#      gt table for readers and, folded, as a Markdown table for text-based
#      readers (agents, diffs, the .md twin of this report)
#   4. an auto-generated plain-language summary of the credible effects
# The tables come from the `rez_*` objects computed in the cached contrasts-*
# chunks, so this costs nothing to re-render.

outcome_info <- list(
  Beauty = list(label = "Beauty", family = "CHOCO", scale = "analog slider rescaled to 0 (Ugly) - 1 (Beautiful)"),
  Beauty2 = list(label = "Beauty (follow-up)", family = "CHOCO", scale = "analog slider rescaled to 0 (Ugly) - 1 (Beautiful), rated again in the follow-up session after the debrief"),
  Reality = list(label = "Syntheticness", family = "CHOCO", scale = "slider rescaled to 0 (AI-Generated) - 1 (Human Creation); higher = judged more human"),
  Authenticity = list(label = "Authenticity", family = "CHOCO", scale = "slider rescaled to 0 (Copy / Forgery) - 1 (Original Creation)"),
  Artificiality = list(label = "Perceived Artificiality", family = "CHOCO", scale = "slider rescaled to 0 (Very Human) - 1 (Very Artificial), follow-up, items judged 'new' only"),
  Valence = list(label = "Valence", family = "Discrete Beta (k = 7)", scale = "7-point pictorial scale coded 1 (Negative) - 7 (Positive); `response` differences are reported in % of the 6-point range", range = 6),
  Meaning = list(label = "Meaning", family = "Discrete Beta (k = 6) with zero hurdle", scale = "0 (Not at all) - 6 (Very much); `response` differences are reported in % of the 6-point range; `pzero` is the probability of answering exactly 0", range = 6),
  Worth = list(label = "Worth", family = "Cumulative (ordinal)", scale = "6 ordered categories $0, $10, $100, $1,000, $10,000, $100,000; `response - <k>` rows are differences in the probability of choosing category k"),
  SelfRelevance = list(label = "Self-Relevance", family = "Cumulative (ordinal)", scale = "7 ordered categories 0 (Not at all) - 6 (Very much); `response - <k>` rows are differences in the probability of choosing category k"),
  Entropy = list(label = "Gaze Entropy", family = "Beta", scale = "normalised spatial entropy of gaze in (0, 1); higher = more dispersed gaze"),
  pLeft = list(label = "Gaze Laterality (pLeft)", family = "Zero-one-inflated Beta", scale = "proportion of gaze samples on the left half of the image (0 - 1)"),
  pCenter = list(label = "Gaze Centeredness (pCenter)", family = "Zero-one-inflated Beta", scale = "proportion of gaze samples in the central region of the image (0 - 1)"),
  Shift = list(label = "Gaze Max. Shift", family = "LogNormal", scale = "largest within-trial relocation of the gaze centroid, in stimulus widths", range = NA)
)

# Parameters that live on a probability / bounded [0, 1] scale and are therefore
# reported in percent. `response` is included unless the outcome has no bounded
# range (range = NA, i.e. Gaze_Shift); for Valence / Meaning it is divided by
# the outcome's range first. Everything else stays raw.
fa_pct_params <- c("mu", "confright", "confleft", "pex", "bex", "pmid", "pzero", "zoi", "coi")
fa_scale_factor <- function(parameter, outcome) {
  info <- outcome_info[[outcome]]
  rng <- if (is.null(info$range)) 1 else info$range
  is_resp <- parameter == "response" | grepl("^response", parameter)
  ifelse(parameter %in% fa_pct_params, 100,
    ifelse(is_resp & !is.na(rng), 100 / rng, NA_real_))
}

param_glossary <- c(
  response = "expected value on the response scale",
  mu = "CHOCO: probability of choosing the upper half of the scale (logit link). Discrete Beta / Beta: mean of the latent Beta",
  confright = "CHOCO: mean confidence (position within the upper half) when the upper half is chosen",
  confleft = "CHOCO: mean confidence within the lower half when the lower half is chosen",
  precright = "CHOCO: precision (inverse spread) of ratings within the upper half",
  precleft = "CHOCO: precision of ratings within the lower half",
  pex = "CHOCO: probability of an extreme response (exactly 0 or 1)",
  bex = "CHOCO: balance of the extreme mass towards 1 (> 0.5) or 0 (< 0.5)",
  pmid = "CHOCO: probability of answering exactly at the midpoint",
  phi = "precision of the latent Beta (higher = more agreement / less dispersion)",
  pzero = "probability of the hurdle category 0",
  sigma = "LogNormal: scale (spread) parameter on the log scale",
  zoi = "probability of an exact 0 or 1", coi = "conditional probability that an extreme is 1 rather than 0",
  disc = "ordinal discrimination"
)

contrast_order <- c("AI-Generated - Human Original", "Human Forgery - Human Original", "AI-Generated - Human Forgery")

fa_asis <- function(...) knitr::asis_output(paste(unlist(list(...)), collapse = "\n"))

fa_prep_contrasts <- function(dat_con, outcome) {
  dat_con <- as.data.frame(dat_con)
  dat_con$Credible <- sign(dat_con$CI_low) == sign(dat_con$CI_high)
  dat_con$Effect <- ifelse(!dat_con$Credible, "n.s.", ifelse(dat_con$Difference < 0, "Negative", "Positive"))
  dat_con$Contrast <- factor(dat_con$Contrast, levels = unique(c(contrast_order, unique(dat_con$Contrast))))
  # Percent of scale range where the parameter has one (see fa_scale_factor)
  k <- fa_scale_factor(dat_con$Parameter, outcome)
  dat_con$Unit <- ifelse(is.na(k), "raw", "%")
  dat_con$Difference_pct <- dat_con$Difference * k
  dat_con$CI_low_pct <- dat_con$CI_low * k
  dat_con$CI_high_pct <- dat_con$CI_high * k
  shown <- function(raw, pct) ifelse(is.na(k), raw, pct)
  d <- shown(dat_con$Difference, dat_con$Difference_pct)
  lo <- shown(dat_con$CI_low, dat_con$CI_low_pct)
  hi <- shown(dat_con$CI_high, dat_con$CI_high_pct)
  dat_con$Diff <- insight::format_value(d, zap_small = TRUE)
  dat_con$CI <- sprintf("[%s, %s]", insight::format_value(lo, zap_small = TRUE), insight::format_value(hi, zap_small = TRUE))
  dat_con$pd_fmt <- if ("pd" %in% names(dat_con)) insight::format_pd(dat_con$pd, name = NULL) else ""
  dat_con[order(dat_con$Contrast), ]
}

# A coloured gt table for humans + the same table as Markdown in a folded
# callout for text-based readers.
fa_tables <- function(df, cols, title, id) {
  tbl <- as.data.frame(df)[cols]
  g <- gt::gt(tbl, groupname_col = if ("Contrast" %in% cols) "Contrast" else NULL) |>
    gt::tab_header(title = title) |>
    gt::opt_stylize(style = 2, color = "gray") |>
    gt::tab_options(table.font.size = gt::px(13), heading.align = "left")
  if ("Effect" %in% cols) {
    g <- g |>
      gt::tab_style(style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#E8F5E9"), locations = gt::cells_body(rows = Effect == "Positive")) |>
      gt::tab_style(style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#FFEBEE"), locations = gt::cells_body(rows = Effect == "Negative")) |>
      gt::tab_style(style = gt::cell_text(color = "#9E9E9E"), locations = gt::cells_body(rows = Effect == "n.s."))
  }
  md <- knitr::kable(tbl, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE)
  fa_asis(
    as.character(knitr::knit_print(g)), # gt HTML with a scoped <style>, not inline CSS
    "",
    sprintf('::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="%s (Markdown table, for text readers)"}', title),
    "",
    md,
    "",
    ":::",
    ""
  )
}

fa_diagnostics <- function(m, outcome) {
  rh <- brms::rhat(m)
  ne <- brms::neff_ratio(m)
  np <- brms::nuts_params(m, pars = "divergent__")
  data.frame(
    Model = outcome,
    Family = outcome_info[[outcome]]$family,
    N_obs = nrow(m$data),
    N_participants = length(unique(m$data$Participant)),
    Chains = brms::nchains(m),
    Draws = brms::ndraws(m),
    Max_Rhat = round(max(rh, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Min_ESS_ratio = round(min(ne, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Divergent_pct = round(100 * mean(np$Value), 2),
    Criterion = paste(names(m$criteria), collapse = ", "),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

fa_means <- function(m) {
  if (m$family$family == "cumulative") {
    # Ordinal: the response-scale mean is meaningless; report the probability
    # of each category per condition instead (marginaleffects gives them).
    out <- estimate_means(m, by = "Condition", predict = "response", backend = "marginaleffects",
                          test = NULL, iterations = 500) |> as.data.frame()
  } else {
    out <- estimate_means(m, by = "Condition", predict = "response", backend = "emmeans", test = NULL) |>
      as.data.frame()
  }
  names(out)[names(out) %in% c("Probability", "Mean", "Median")] <- "Estimate"
  out[intersect(c("Condition", "Response", "Estimate", "CI_low", "CI_high"), names(out))]
}

# Plain-language summary generated from the numbers, so it is never stale.
fa_describe <- function(dat, dat_emo, outcome) {
  info <- outcome_info[[outcome]]
  main_pars <- c("response", "mu")
  out <- c(sprintf("**%s** (%s). Scale: %s. Differences are posterior medians with 95%% CI, in %% of the scale range for bounded parameters and on the parameter's own scale for those marked `raw`; `pd` is the probability of direction. An effect is called credible when the CI excludes 0.", info$label, info$family, info$scale), "")
  for (con in levels(dat$Contrast)) {
    d <- dat[dat$Contrast == con, ]
    if (nrow(d) == 0) next
    cred <- d[d$Credible, ]
    if (nrow(cred) == 0) {
      out <- c(out, sprintf("- **%s**: no credible difference on any parameter (%s).", con, paste(unique(d$Parameter), collapse = ", ")))
      next
    }
    cred <- cred[order(!cred$Parameter %in% main_pars & !grepl("^response", cred$Parameter), cred$Parameter), ]
    up <- cred[cred$Difference > 0, ]; down <- cred[cred$Difference < 0, ]
    fmt <- function(x) paste(sprintf("`%s` %s%s %s", x$Parameter, x$Diff, ifelse(x$Unit == "%", "%", ""), x$CI), collapse = "; ")
    parts <- c(if (nrow(down)) sprintf("lower %s", fmt(down)), if (nrow(up)) sprintf("higher %s", fmt(up)))
    ns <- setdiff(unique(d$Parameter), cred$Parameter)
    out <- c(out, sprintf("- **%s**: %s.%s", con, paste(parts, collapse = "; "),
                          if (length(ns)) sprintf(" No credible difference on %s.", paste0("`", ns, "`", collapse = ", ")) else ""))
  }
  if (!is.null(dat_emo) && nrow(dat_emo) > 0 && "Emotion" %in% names(dat_emo)) {
    out <- c(out, "", "By stimulus emotion (same contrasts within each valence x arousal quadrant, main parameter only):")
    for (con in levels(dat$Contrast)) {
      d <- dat_emo[dat_emo$Contrast == con & (dat_emo$Parameter %in% main_pars | grepl("^response", dat_emo$Parameter)), ]
      if (nrow(d) == 0) next
      d <- d[d$Parameter == d$Parameter[1], ] # first main parameter available
      cred <- d[d$Credible, ]
      out <- c(out, sprintf("- **%s** on `%s`: credible in %s%s.", con, d$Parameter[1],
                            if (nrow(cred)) paste(sprintf("%s (%s%s %s)", cred$Emotion, cred$Diff, ifelse(cred$Unit == "%", "%", ""), cred$CI), collapse = ", ") else "no quadrant",
                            if (nrow(cred) && nrow(cred) < nrow(d)) sprintf("; not in %s", paste(setdiff(d$Emotion, cred$Emotion), collapse = ", ")) else ""))
    }
  }
  fa_asis("", '::: {.callout-tip title="Summary of credible effects (generated from the tables above)"}', "", out, "", ":::", "")
}

# Expensive part (cached per model): diagnostics + marginal means + the raw
# contrast tables. No formatting here, so that fa_print() can change without
# invalidating the cache.
fa_report <- function(m, rez, rez_emo, outcome, rez_extra = NULL, extra_title = "Emotion contrasts") {
  list(
    outcome = outcome,
    extra_title = extra_title,
    diag = fa_diagnostics(m, outcome),
    means = fa_means(m),
    contrasts = fa_prep_contrasts(rez$dat_con, outcome),
    contrasts_emo = fa_prep_contrasts(rez_emo$dat_con, outcome),
    contrasts_extra = if (!is.null(rez_extra)) fa_prep_contrasts(rez_extra$dat_con, outcome) else NULL
  )
}

# Cheap part (never cached): the tables and the generated summary.
fa_print <- function(rep) {
  info <- outcome_info[[rep$outcome]]
  id <- tolower(rep$outcome)
  # Recompute the derived columns so a change in fa_prep_contrasts() shows up
  # without refitting anything.
  dat <- fa_prep_contrasts(rep$contrasts, rep$outcome)
  dat_emo <- fa_prep_contrasts(rep$contrasts_emo, rep$outcome)
  extra <- if (!is.null(rep$contrasts_extra)) fa_prep_contrasts(rep$contrasts_extra, rep$outcome) else NULL
  means_fmt <- rep$means
  num <- vapply(means_fmt, is.numeric, logical(1))
  means_fmt[num] <- lapply(means_fmt[num], insight::format_value, zap_small = TRUE)
  cols <- c("Contrast", "Parameter", "Diff", "CI", "Unit", "pd_fmt", "Effect")
  fa_asis(
    fa_tables(rep$diag, c("Model", "Family", "N_obs", "N_participants", "Chains", "Draws", "Max_Rhat", "Min_ESS_ratio", "Divergent_pct", "Criterion"),
              sprintf("%s: convergence", info$label), id),
    fa_tables(means_fmt, names(means_fmt),
              sprintf("%s: marginal means per label condition (response scale)", info$label), id),
    fa_tables(dat, cols, sprintf("%s: all contrasts between label conditions", info$label), id),
    if (!is.null(extra)) fa_tables(extra, cols, sprintf("%s: %s", info$label, rep$extra_title), id) else "",
    sprintf('::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="%s: contrasts within each stimulus emotion (Markdown table)"}', info$label),
    "",
    knitr::kable(dat_emo[c("Emotion", cols)], format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE),
    "",
    ":::",
    fa_describe(dat, dat_emo, rep$outcome)
  )
}
```

### Phase 1


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
p_dist_beauty <- dftask |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=Beauty)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y=after_stat(density)), bins = 47, fill = colorRampPalette(c("#1976D2", "#0D47A1"))(47))

  ggplot(aes(x=Valence)) +
  geom_bar(fill = colorRampPalette(c("#388E3C", "#1B5E20"))(7)) 
  
p_dist_meaning <- dftask |>

p_dist_worth <- dftask |>
```

```{.r .cell-code}
m_beauty <- readRDS("models/Beauty.rds")
```

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
get_contrasts <- function(m, outcome = "Beauty", contrast = "Condition", by = NULL, backend = "emmeans") {
  dat_con <- data.frame()
  
  params <- c("response", "mu", insight::find_auxiliary(m))
  if(outcome %in% c("Worth", "SelfRelevance")) params <- params[!params %in% c("disc")]
  if(outcome %in% c("pLeft", "pCenter")) params <- params[!params %in% c("zoi", "coi")]
  for(par in params) {
    if(!is.null(by) && par %in% c("pmid", "pex", "bex", "disc")) next
    # cat(par, " * ")
    
    c <- estimate_contrasts(m, contrast = contrast, by = by, predict = par, 
                            backend = backend, test = "pd", iterations = 500) 
    
    if(outcome %in% c("Worth", "SelfRelevance") && par == "response") {
      c <- filter(c, Response1 == Response2)
      c <- mutate(c, Parameter = paste0("response - ", Response1))
      c <- data_remove(c, c("Response1", "Response2"))
    } else {
      c <- mutate(c, Parameter = par)
    }
    
    dat_con <- rbind(dat_con, c)
  }
  
  if(backend == "marginaleffects") dat_con <- data_rename(dat_con, select = "Median", "Difference")
  dat_con$Outcome <- outcome
  dat_con$Contrast <- paste(str_remove(str_remove(dat_con$Level1, "\\("), "\\)"), 
                            "-", 
                            str_remove(str_remove(dat_con$Level2, "\\("), "\\)")) 
  
  rez_con <- filter(dat_con, sign(CI_low) == sign(CI_high)) 
  if(nrow(rez_con) == 0) {
    rez_con <- data.frame(Contrast = unique(dat_con$Contrast), Parameters = "None")
  } else {
    rez_con <- rez_con |>
      format_table(zap_small = TRUE) |> 
      mutate(param_string = paste0(Parameter, " (", Difference, ", ", CI, ")")) |> 
      summarise(Parameters = paste(param_string, collapse = "; "), .by = "Contrast")
  }
  
  list(rez_con = rez_con, dat_con = dat_con)
}
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
rez_beauty <- get_contrasts(m_beauty, outcome = "Beauty", contrast = "Condition")
```

**Beauty** (CHOCO). Scale: analog slider rescaled to 0 (Ugly) - 1 (Beautiful). Differences are posterior medians with 95% CI, in % of the scale range for bounded parameters and on the parameter's own scale for those marked `raw`; `pd` is the probability of direction. An effect is called credible when the CI excludes 0.

- **AI-Generated - Human Original**: lower `mu` -15.89% [-19.26, -12.39]; `response` -7.03% [-8.21, -5.90]; `confright` -6.33% [-7.43, -5.17]; `pex` -0.24% [-0.57, -0.06]; higher `confleft` 4.18% [2.49, 5.87]; `precright` 0.97 [0.61, 1.40]. No credible difference on `precleft`, `bex`, `pmid`.
- **Human Forgery - Human Original**: lower `mu` -6.67% [-9.46, -3.97]; `response` -3.65% [-4.62, -2.73]; `confright` -4.26% [-5.29, -3.18]; higher `confleft` 2.55% [0.83, 4.24]; `precleft` 0.29 [0.01, 0.59]; `precright` 0.90 [0.48, 1.34]. No credible difference on `pex`, `bex`, `pmid`.
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery**: lower `mu` -9.20% [-12.55, -5.74]; `response` -3.37% [-4.47, -2.34]; `confright` -2.07% [-3.19, -0.98]; `precleft` -0.32 [-0.62, -0.03]; higher `pmid` 0.70% [0.21, 1.26]. No credible difference on `confleft`, `precright`, `pex`, `bex`.

```{.r .cell-code}
get_marginal_parameters <- function(m, by = "Condition") {
  # 1. Get predicted averages
  dat_par <- estimate_means(m, by = by, predict = "response", backend = "emmeans", test = NULL) |>
    datawizard::data_rename(
      select = c("Probability", "CI_low", "CI_high"),
      replacement = c("Mean", "Mean_low", "Mean_high")
    ) 
  
  # 2. Get predicted parameters
  for (par in c("mu", "confright", "confleft", "precright", "precleft", "pex", "bex", "pmid")) {
    # cat(par, " * ")
    if(par %in% c("pex", "bex", "pmid")) by <- "Condition" # Overwrite for last params
      dat_par <- estimate_means(m, by = by, predict = par, backend = "emmeans", test = NULL) |>
      datawizard::data_rename(
        select = c("CI_low", "CI_high"),
        replacement = paste0(tools::toTitleCase(par), c("_low", "_high"))
      ) |>
      full_join(dat_par, by = by)
    }
  dat_par
}


get_marginal_densities <- function(dat_par, adjust = 2) {
  
  # 3. Get corresponding densities
  dat_dens <- data.frame()
  dat_annot <- data.frame()
  for (row in 1:nrow(dat_par)) {
    x <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 201)
    # Compute density line
    y <- dchoco(
      x = x, p = dat_par$Mu[row], confleft = dat_par$Confleft[row], confright = dat_par$Confright[row],
      precleft = dat_par$Precleft[row], precright = dat_par$Precright[row],
      pmid = dat_par$Pmid[row], pex = dat_par$Pex[row], bex = dat_par$Bex[row]
    ) 
    y <- y * adjust # Aesthetic adjustment for the plot so that it matches the histogram
    dat_dens <- rbind(dat_dens, data.frame(Condition = dat_par$Condition[row], x = x, y = y))
  
    # Find particular points coordinates
    dat_annot <- rbind(dat_annot, data.frame(
      Condition = dat_par$Condition[row],
      right_y = max(y[x > 0.5]), left_y = max(y[x < 0.5]),
      right_x = 0.5 + x[which.max(y[x > 0.5])], left_x = x[which.max(y[x < 0.5])],
      right_size = dat_par$Mu[row], left_size = 1 - dat_par$Mu[row]
    ))
  }
  
  
  offset <- 1 - (rev(as.numeric(dat_par$Condition)) / 3)
  max_y <- max(dat_dens$y)
  dat_par$Mean_y <- 1.2 * max_y - offset * (1.2 * max_y - max_y)
  
  list(par=dat_par, dens=dat_dens, annot=dat_annot)
}


get_choco_plot <- function(dat, title = "Beauty", observed = title, xlabs = c("0% - Ugly", "100% - Beautiful"), facet = NULL, ...) {
   dat_obs <- dftask
   dat_obs$obs <- dat_obs[[observed]]
   dat_obs <- dat_obs[!is.na(dat_obs$obs), ]
  
  p <- dat$dens |>
    ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_histogram(data = dat_obs, aes(x = obs, y = after_stat(density)), alpha = 0.1, bins = 47) +
    geom_segment(data = dat$annot, aes(
      x = right_x, xend = right_x,
      y = 0, yend = right_y, color = Condition
    ), linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_segment(data = dat$annot, aes(
      x = left_x, xend = left_x,
      y = 0, yend = left_y, color = Condition
    ), linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(data = dat$annot, aes(x = right_x, y = 0, color = Condition, size = right_size * 6)) +
    geom_point(data = dat$annot, aes(x = left_x, y = 0, color = Condition, size = left_size * 6)) +
    geom_pointrange(data = dat$par, aes(x = Mean, y = Mean_y, xmin = Mean_low, xmax = Mean_high, color = Condition), linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(color = Condition), linewidth = 1) +
    labs(y = "Likelihood of Response", title = title) +
    scale_size_identity() +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), 
                       labels = c(xlabs[1], "25%", "50%",  "75%", xlabs[2])) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  if(!is.null(facet)) p <- p + facet_wrap(facet, ...)
  p
}
```

```{.r .cell-code}
p_beauty
```

```{.r .cell-code}
par_beauty_condemo <- get_marginal_parameters(m_beauty, by = c("Condition", "Emotion"))

dens_beauty_condemo <- list(par = data.frame(), dens = data.frame(), annot = data.frame())
for(emo in unique(par_beauty_condemo$Emotion)) {
  dat <- get_marginal_densities(par_beauty_condemo[par_beauty_condemo$Emotion == emo, ], adjust = 0.8)
  dat[["dens"]]$Emotion <- emo 
  dat[["annot"]]$Emotion <- emo
  dens_beauty_condemo[["par"]] <- rbind(dens_beauty_condemo[["par"]], dat[["par"]])
  dens_beauty_condemo[["dens"]] <- rbind(dens_beauty_condemo[["dens"]], dat[["dens"]])
  dens_beauty_condemo[["annot"]] <- rbind(dens_beauty_condemo[["annot"]], dat[["annot"]])
}
dens_beauty_condemo$dens$Emotion <- fct_relevel(dens_beauty_condemo$dens$Emotion, rev(levels(dftask$Emotion)))
dens_beauty_condemo$annot$Emotion <- fct_relevel(dens_beauty_condemo$annot$Emotion, rev(levels(dftask$Emotion)))
p_beauty_emo <- get_choco_plot(dens_beauty_condemo, title = "Beauty", 
                               xlabs = c("0%\nUgly", "100%\nBeautiful"), facet = ~Emotion)
p_beauty_emo
```

::: {.callout-tip title="Summary of credible effects (generated from the tables above)"}

**Valence** (Discrete Beta (k = 7)). Scale: 7-point pictorial scale coded 1 (Negative) - 7 (Positive); `response` differences are reported in % of the 6-point range. Differences are posterior medians with 95% CI, in % of the scale range for bounded parameters and on the parameter's own scale for those marked `raw`; `pd` is the probability of direction. An effect is called credible when the CI excludes 0.

- **AI-Generated - Human Original**: lower `mu` -5.47% [-6.40, -4.59]; `response` -6.17% [-7.20, -5.19]; higher `phi` 0.48 [0.02, 0.96].
- **Human Forgery - Human Original**: lower `mu` -3.10% [-3.84, -2.36]; `response` -3.51% [-4.34, -2.68]; higher `phi` 0.49 [0.06, 0.93].
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery**: lower `mu` -2.38% [-3.22, -1.54]; `response` -2.67% [-3.63, -1.73]. No credible difference on `phi`.

By stimulus emotion (same contrasts within each valence x arousal quadrant, main parameter only):
- **AI-Generated - Human Original** on `response`: credible in Positive - Low intensity (-6.46% [-7.95, -4.96]), Negative - Low intensity (-6.28% [-7.92, -4.64]), Positive - High intensity (-7.22% [-8.90, -5.55]), Negative - High intensity (-4.72% [-6.61, -2.93]).
- **Human Forgery - Human Original** on `response`: credible in Positive - Low intensity (-3.84% [-5.21, -2.50]), Negative - Low intensity (-3.87% [-5.37, -2.37]), Positive - High intensity (-4.47% [-5.98, -3.02]), Negative - High intensity (-1.85% [-3.51, -0.19]).
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery** on `response`: credible in Positive - Low intensity (-2.62% [-4.06, -1.26]), Negative - Low intensity (-2.42% [-3.97, -0.85]), Positive - High intensity (-2.74% [-4.38, -1.13]), Negative - High intensity (-2.88% [-4.67, -1.16]).

::: {#fig-valence .cell layout-ncol="1"}

```{.r .cell-code}
get_discrete_plot <- function(pred, title = "Valence", observed = title, facet = NULL, ...) {
   dat_obs <- dftask
   dat_obs$obs <- dat_obs[[observed]]
   dat_obs <- dat_obs[!is.na(dat_obs$obs), ]
   
   if(title == "Worth") dat_obs$obs <- as.numeric(dat_obs$obs)
   
   stratifiers <- c("Condition")
   if(!is.null(facet)) stratifiers <- c(stratifiers, "Emotion")
   
   pred_long <- reshape_iterations(pred) |>
     summarize(N = n(), .by = all_of(c(stratifiers, "iter_group", "iter_value"))) |>
      mutate(
        p = N / sum(N),
        .by = all_of(c(stratifiers, "iter_group"))
      ) |>
      summarise(
        median = median(p),
        lower = quantile(p, .025),
        upper = quantile(p, .975),
        .by = all_of(c(stratifiers, "iter_value"))
      )
  
  p <- dat_obs |>
    ggplot(aes(x = obs)) +
    geom_bar(alpha = 0.5, aes(y = after_stat(prop))) +
    geom_line(
    data = pred_long,
    aes(x = iter_value, y = median, group = Condition, colour = Condition), 
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.25, reverse = TRUE), linewidth = 1
  )  +
    geom_pointrange(
    data = pred_long,
    aes(x = iter_value, y = median,  ymin = lower,  ymax = upper,  color = Condition),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.25, reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
    labs(y = "Likelihood of Response", title = title) +
    scale_size_identity() +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  if(!is.null(facet)) p <- p + facet_wrap(facet, ...)
  p
}


pred <- estimate_prediction(m_valence, ci = NULL, iterations = 100, keep_iterations = TRUE, centrality = "median") 
get_discrete_plot(pred, title = "Valence") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:7, labels = c("-3\nNegative", "-2", "-1", "0", "+1", "+2", "+3\nPositive"))

get_discrete_plot(pred, title = "Valence", facet = ~Emotion) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:7, labels = c("-3\nNegative", "-2", "-1", "0", "+1", "+2", "+3\nPositive"))
```

::: {.callout-tip title="Summary of credible effects (generated from the tables above)"}

**Meaning** (Discrete Beta (k = 6) with zero hurdle). Scale: 0 (Not at all) - 6 (Very much); `response` differences are reported in % of the 6-point range; `pzero` is the probability of answering exactly 0. Differences are posterior medians with 95% CI, in % of the scale range for bounded parameters and on the parameter's own scale for those marked `raw`; `pd` is the probability of direction. An effect is called credible when the CI excludes 0.

- **AI-Generated - Human Original**: lower `mu` -8.60% [-9.85, -7.35]; `response` -10.51% [-12.05, -9.08]; higher `pzero` 5.15% [3.20, 7.86]. No credible difference on `phi`.
- **Human Forgery - Human Original**: lower `mu` -3.95% [-4.94, -2.97]; `response` -4.24% [-5.28, -3.21]; higher `pzero` 0.93% [0.22, 1.85]. No credible difference on `phi`.
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery**: lower `mu` -4.64% [-5.82, -3.46]; `response` -6.26% [-7.73, -4.89]; `phi` -0.36 [-0.71, 0.00]; higher `pzero` 4.21% [2.44, 6.64].

By stimulus emotion (same contrasts within each valence x arousal quadrant, main parameter only):
- **AI-Generated - Human Original** on `response`: credible in Positive - Low intensity (-9.14% [-11.67, -6.95]), Negative - Low intensity (-10.10% [-12.63, -7.88]), Positive - High intensity (-9.79% [-12.47, -7.36]), Negative - High intensity (-12.92% [-15.70, -10.39]).
- **Human Forgery - Human Original** on `response`: credible in Positive - Low intensity (-4.00% [-5.65, -2.35]), Negative - Low intensity (-3.46% [-5.31, -1.70]), Positive - High intensity (-4.78% [-6.58, -3.02]), Negative - High intensity (-4.69% [-6.69, -2.80]).
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery** on `response`: credible in Positive - Low intensity (-5.12% [-7.54, -3.08]), Negative - Low intensity (-6.62% [-9.12, -4.38]), Positive - High intensity (-5.01% [-7.59, -2.74]), Negative - High intensity (-8.22% [-10.80, -5.78]).

:::

```{.r .cell-code}
pred <- estimate_prediction(m_meaning, ci = NULL, iterations = 100, keep_iterations = TRUE, centrality = "median") 
get_discrete_plot(pred, title = "Meaning") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:6, labels = c("0\nNot at all", 1:5, "6\nVery much"))

get_discrete_plot(pred, title = "Meaning", facet = ~Emotion) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:6, labels = c("0\nNot at all", 1:5, "6\nVery much"))
```

::: {.callout-tip title="Summary of credible effects (generated from the tables above)"}

**Worth** (Cumulative (ordinal)). Scale: 6 ordered categories $0, $10, $100, $1,000, $10,000, $100,000; `response - <k>` rows are differences in the probability of choosing category k. Differences are posterior medians with 95% CI, in % of the scale range for bounded parameters and on the parameter's own scale for those marked `raw`; `pd` is the probability of direction. An effect is called credible when the CI excludes 0.

- **AI-Generated - Human Original**: lower `mu` -23.84% [-25.75, -22.04]; `response - 100` -7.17% [-7.98, -6.38]; `response - 1000` -8.81% [-9.50, -8.21]; `response - 10000` -3.04% [-3.49, -2.66]; `response - 100000` -0.62% [-0.79, -0.48]; higher `response - 0` 18.28% [17.02, 19.57]; `response - 10` 1.34% [0.47, 2.16].
- **Human Forgery - Human Original**: lower `mu` -13.58% [-15.12, -12.09]; `response - 100` -3.08% [-3.79, -2.35]; `response - 1000` -5.46% [-6.09, -4.85]; `response - 10000` -2.24% [-2.60, -1.90]; `response - 100000` -0.44% [-0.60, -0.31]; higher `response - 0` 9.55% [8.35, 10.76]; `response - 10` 1.66% [1.03, 2.38].
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery**: lower `mu` -10.15% [-12.03, -8.44]; `response - 100` -4.11% [-4.82, -3.41]; `response - 1000` -3.36% [-3.92, -2.80]; `response - 10000` -0.80% [-1.05, -0.54]; `response - 100000` -0.18% [-0.26, -0.11]; higher `response - 0` 8.75% [7.43, 10.17]. No credible difference on `response - 10`.

By stimulus emotion (same contrasts within each valence x arousal quadrant, main parameter only):
- **AI-Generated - Human Original** on `response - 0`: credible in Positive - Low intensity (18.38% [16.27, 20.45]), Negative - Low intensity (20.54% [17.79, 23.03]), Positive - High intensity (17.54% [14.87, 20.06]), Negative - High intensity (17.21% [14.88, 19.60]).
- **Human Forgery - Human Original** on `response - 0`: credible in Positive - Low intensity (9.44% [7.63, 11.28]), Negative - Low intensity (10.14% [7.75, 12.41]), Positive - High intensity (10.01% [7.77, 12.32]), Negative - High intensity (8.54% [6.18, 10.78]).
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery** on `response - 0`: credible in Positive - Low intensity (8.94% [6.64, 11.19]), Negative - Low intensity (10.35% [7.73, 13.15]), Positive - High intensity (7.44% [4.74, 10.30]), Negative - High intensity (8.80% [6.07, 11.31]).

::: {.callout-tip title="Summary of credible effects (generated from the tables above)"}

**Gaze Entropy** (Beta). Scale: normalised spatial entropy of gaze in (0, 1); higher = more dispersed gaze. Differences are posterior medians with 95% CI, in % of the scale range for bounded parameters and on the parameter's own scale for those marked `raw`; `pd` is the probability of direction. An effect is called credible when the CI excludes 0.

- **AI-Generated - Human Original**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, phi).
- **Human Forgery - Human Original**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, phi).
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, phi).

By stimulus emotion (same contrasts within each valence x arousal quadrant, main parameter only):
- **AI-Generated - Human Original** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.
- **Human Forgery - Human Original** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.

:::

:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pred <- estimate_prediction(m_entropy, ci = NULL, iterations = 50, keep_iterations = TRUE) |> 
  reshape_iterations()

dftask |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=Gaze_Entropy)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y=after_stat(density)), bins = 40) +
  geom_line(data = pred, stat = "density", alpha = 0.5,
            aes(x = iter_value, group = interaction(Condition, iter_group), color = Condition))
```

::: {.callout-tip title="Summary of credible effects (generated from the tables above)"}

**Gaze Laterality (pLeft)** (Zero-one-inflated Beta). Scale: proportion of gaze samples on the left half of the image (0 - 1). Differences are posterior medians with 95% CI, in % of the scale range for bounded parameters and on the parameter's own scale for those marked `raw`; `pd` is the probability of direction. An effect is called credible when the CI excludes 0.

- **AI-Generated - Human Original**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, phi).
- **Human Forgery - Human Original**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, phi).
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, phi).

By stimulus emotion (same contrasts within each valence x arousal quadrant, main parameter only):
- **AI-Generated - Human Original** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.
- **Human Forgery - Human Original** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.

:::

```{.r .cell-code}
pred <- estimate_prediction(m_pleft, ci = NULL, iterations = 50, keep_iterations = TRUE) |> 
  reshape_iterations()

dftask |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=Gaze_pLeft)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y=after_stat(density)), bins = 40) +
  geom_line(data = pred, stat = "density", alpha = 0.5,
            aes(x = iter_value, group = interaction(Condition, iter_group), color = Condition))
```

::: {.callout-tip title="Summary of credible effects (generated from the tables above)"}

**Gaze Centeredness (pCenter)** (Zero-one-inflated Beta). Scale: proportion of gaze samples in the central region of the image (0 - 1). Differences are posterior medians with 95% CI, in % of the scale range for bounded parameters and on the parameter's own scale for those marked `raw`; `pd` is the probability of direction. An effect is called credible when the CI excludes 0.

- **AI-Generated - Human Original**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, phi).
- **Human Forgery - Human Original**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, phi).
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, phi).

By stimulus emotion (same contrasts within each valence x arousal quadrant, main parameter only):
- **AI-Generated - Human Original** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.
- **Human Forgery - Human Original** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.

:::

```{.r .cell-code}
pred <- estimate_prediction(m_pcenter, ci = NULL, iterations = 50, keep_iterations = TRUE) |> 
  reshape_iterations()

dftask |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=Gaze_pCenter)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y=after_stat(density)), bins = 40) +
  geom_line(data = pred, stat = "density", alpha = 0.5,
            aes(x = iter_value, group = interaction(Condition, iter_group), color = Condition))
```

::: {.callout-tip title="Summary of credible effects (generated from the tables above)"}

**Gaze Max. Shift** (LogNormal). Scale: largest within-trial relocation of the gaze centroid, in stimulus widths. Differences are posterior medians with 95% CI, in % of the scale range for bounded parameters and on the parameter's own scale for those marked `raw`; `pd` is the probability of direction. An effect is called credible when the CI excludes 0.

- **AI-Generated - Human Original**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, sigma).
- **Human Forgery - Human Original**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, sigma).
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, sigma).

By stimulus emotion (same contrasts within each valence x arousal quadrant, main parameter only):
- **AI-Generated - Human Original** on `response`: credible in Positive - Low intensity (0.02 [0.01, 0.03]); not in Negative - Low intensity, Positive - High intensity, Negative - High intensity.
- **Human Forgery - Human Original** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery** on `response`: credible in Positive - Low intensity (0.02 [0.01, 0.03]); not in Negative - Low intensity, Positive - High intensity, Negative - High intensity.

:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pred <- estimate_prediction(m_shift, ci = NULL, iterations = 500, keep_iterations = TRUE) |> 
  reshape_iterations()

dftask |> 
  # filter(Emotion == "Positiev - Low intensity") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=Gaze_Shift)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y=after_stat(density)), bins = 100) +
  geom_line(data = pred, stat = "density", alpha = 0.05,
            aes(x = iter_value, group = interaction(Condition, iter_group), color = Condition)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~Emotion)
```

::: {.callout-tip title="Summary of credible effects (generated from the tables above)"}

**Syntheticness** (CHOCO). Scale: slider rescaled to 0 (AI-Generated) - 1 (Human Creation); higher = judged more human. Differences are posterior medians with 95% CI, in % of the scale range for bounded parameters and on the parameter's own scale for those marked `raw`; `pd` is the probability of direction. An effect is called credible when the CI excludes 0.

- **AI-Generated - Human Original**: lower `mu` -7.97% [-10.30, -5.70]; `response` -5.44% [-6.84, -4.08]; `confright` -2.47% [-3.48, -1.48]; higher `pex` 0.14% [0.03, 0.38]. No credible difference on `confleft`, `precright`, `precleft`, `bex`, `pmid`.
- **Human Forgery - Human Original**: lower `response` -1.45% [-2.82, -0.03]. No credible difference on `mu`, `confright`, `confleft`, `precright`, `precleft`, `pex`, `bex`, `pmid`.
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery**: lower `mu` -5.97% [-8.48, -3.53]; `response` -4.00% [-5.49, -2.50]; `confright` -1.56% [-2.68, -0.44]. No credible difference on `confleft`, `precright`, `precleft`, `pex`, `bex`, `pmid`.

By stimulus emotion (same contrasts within each valence x arousal quadrant, main parameter only):
- **AI-Generated - Human Original** on `response`: credible in Positive - Low intensity (-4.58% [-7.20, -1.87]), Negative - Low intensity (-4.48% [-7.07, -1.86]), Positive - High intensity (-7.04% [-9.85, -4.32]), Negative - High intensity (-5.68% [-8.57, -2.74]).
- **Human Forgery - Human Original** on `response`: credible in Positive - High intensity (-2.85% [-5.67, -0.11]); not in Positive - Low intensity, Negative - Low intensity, Negative - High intensity.
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery** on `response`: credible in Positive - Low intensity (-3.73% [-6.47, -0.93]), Negative - Low intensity (-3.89% [-6.63, -1.14]), Positive - High intensity (-4.19% [-7.12, -1.16]), Negative - High intensity (-4.18% [-7.25, -1.17]).

:::

```{.r .cell-code}
par_reality <- get_marginal_parameters(m_reality)

p_reality
```

::: {.callout-tip title="Summary of credible effects (generated from the tables above)"}

**Authenticity** (CHOCO). Scale: slider rescaled to 0 (Copy / Forgery) - 1 (Original Creation). Differences are posterior medians with 95% CI, in % of the scale range for bounded parameters and on the parameter's own scale for those marked `raw`; `pd` is the probability of direction. An effect is called credible when the CI excludes 0.

- **AI-Generated - Human Original**: lower `response` -1.35% [-2.56, -0.12]. No credible difference on `mu`, `confright`, `confleft`, `precright`, `precleft`, `pex`, `bex`, `pmid`.
- **Human Forgery - Human Original**: lower `mu` -3.50% [-5.54, -1.39]; `response` -2.03% [-3.22, -0.79]. No credible difference on `confright`, `confleft`, `precright`, `precleft`, `pex`, `bex`, `pmid`.
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, confright, confleft, precright, precleft, pex, bex, pmid).

By stimulus emotion (same contrasts within each valence x arousal quadrant, main parameter only):
- **AI-Generated - Human Original** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.
- **Human Forgery - Human Original** on `response`: credible in Positive - High intensity (-3.40% [-5.83, -0.97]), Negative - High intensity (-2.74% [-5.21, -0.26]); not in Positive - Low intensity, Negative - Low intensity.
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.

::: {.callout-tip title="Summary of credible effects (generated from the tables above)"}

**Beauty (follow-up)** (CHOCO). Scale: analog slider rescaled to 0 (Ugly) - 1 (Beautiful), rated again in the follow-up session after the debrief. Differences are posterior medians with 95% CI, in % of the scale range for bounded parameters and on the parameter's own scale for those marked `raw`; `pd` is the probability of direction. An effect is called credible when the CI excludes 0.

- **AI-Generated - Human Original**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, confright, confleft, precright, precleft, pex, bex, pmid).
- **Human Forgery - Human Original**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, confright, confleft, precright, precleft, pex, bex, pmid).
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, confright, confleft, precright, precleft, pex, bex, pmid).

By stimulus emotion (same contrasts within each valence x arousal quadrant, main parameter only):
- **AI-Generated - Human Original** on `response`: credible in Positive - High intensity (-2.63% [-4.89, -0.51]); not in Negative - High intensity, Negative - Low intensity, Positive - Low intensity.
- **Human Forgery - Human Original** on `response`: credible in Positive - High intensity (-2.43% [-4.81, -0.15]); not in Negative - High intensity, Negative - Low intensity, Positive - Low intensity.
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.

:::

:::
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
par_beauty2 <- get_marginal_parameters(m_beauty2)
dens_beauty2 <- get_marginal_densities(par_beauty2, adjust = 0.5)
p_beauty2 <- get_choco_plot(dens_beauty2, title = "Beauty2", xlabs = c("0%\nUgly", "100%\nBeautiful"))
p_beauty2
```

::: {.callout-tip title="Summary of credible effects (generated from the tables above)"}

**Self-Relevance** (Cumulative (ordinal)). Scale: 7 ordered categories 0 (Not at all) - 6 (Very much); `response - <k>` rows are differences in the probability of choosing category k. Differences are posterior medians with 95% CI, in % of the scale range for bounded parameters and on the parameter's own scale for those marked `raw`; `pd` is the probability of direction. An effect is called credible when the CI excludes 0.

- **AI-Generated - Human Original**: no credible difference on any parameter (response - 0, response - 1, response - 2, response - 3, response - 4, response - 5, response - 6, mu).
- **Human Forgery - Human Original**: no credible difference on any parameter (response - 0, response - 1, response - 2, response - 3, response - 4, response - 5, response - 6, mu).
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery**: no credible difference on any parameter (response - 0, response - 1, response - 2, response - 3, response - 4, response - 5, response - 6, mu).

By stimulus emotion (same contrasts within each valence x arousal quadrant, main parameter only):
- **AI-Generated - Human Original** on `response - 0`: credible in Negative - Low intensity (2.29% [0.07, 4.68]); not in Positive - Low intensity, Positive - High intensity, Negative - High intensity.
- **Human Forgery - Human Original** on `response - 0`: credible in no quadrant.
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery** on `response - 0`: credible in no quadrant.

:::

|Positive - Low intensity  |AI-Generated - Human Forgery   |precleft  |0.02  |[-0.87, 0.87]  |raw  |51.66% |n.s.     |
|Negative - Low intensity  |AI-Generated - Human Forgery   |precleft  |-0.41 |[-1.63, 0.79]  |raw  |75.23% |n.s.     |
|Positive - High intensity |AI-Generated - Human Forgery   |precleft  |-0.59 |[-2.13, 1.00]  |raw  |78.38% |n.s.     |
|Negative - High intensity |AI-Generated - Human Forgery   |precleft  |0.20  |[-1.36, 1.80]  |raw  |60.55% |n.s.     |

:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Summary of credible effects (generated from the tables above)"}

**Perceived Artificiality** (CHOCO). Scale: slider rescaled to 0 (Very Human) - 1 (Very Artificial), follow-up, items judged 'new' only. Differences are posterior medians with 95% CI, in % of the scale range for bounded parameters and on the parameter's own scale for those marked `raw`; `pd` is the probability of direction. An effect is called credible when the CI excludes 0.

- **AI-Generated - Human Original**: no credible difference on any parameter (response, mu, confright, confleft, precright, precleft, pex, bex, pmid).
- **Human Forgery - Human Original**: lower `pmid` -0.34% [-0.75, -0.07]. No credible difference on `response`, `mu`, `confright`, `confleft`, `precright`, `precleft`, `pex`, `bex`.
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery**: higher `pmid` 0.30% [0.03, 0.67]. No credible difference on `response`, `mu`, `confright`, `confleft`, `precright`, `precleft`, `pex`, `bex`.

By stimulus emotion (same contrasts within each valence x arousal quadrant, main parameter only):
- **AI-Generated - Human Original** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.
- **Human Forgery - Human Original** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.
- **AI-Generated - Human Forgery** on `response`: credible in no quadrant.

:::

:::
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
par_artificiality <- get_marginal_parameters(m_artificiality)
dens_artificiality <- get_marginal_densities(par_artificiality, adjust = 0.8)
p_artificiality <- get_choco_plot(dens_artificiality, title = "Artificiality", observed = "PerceivedArtificiality", xlabs = c("0%\nVery Human", "100%\nVery Artificial"))
p_artificiality
```

## Summary

All contrasts of all models, pooled. Two CSVs are written for downstream use
and for text-based readers:

- `data/results_contrasts.csv`: every contrast x parameter x (overall or
  emotion quadrant), unscaled (each on its own parameter / response scale, see
  the glossary above).
- `data/results_means.csv`: marginal means per label condition, response
  scale, for every model.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
reps <- list(rep_beauty, rep_valence, rep_meaning, rep_worth,
             rep_entropy, rep_pleft, rep_pcenter, rep_shift,
             rep_reality, rep_authenticity,
             rep_beauty2, rep_selfrelevance, rep_artificiality)

results_contrasts <- bind_rows(
  lapply(reps, function(r) mutate(r$contrasts, Emotion = "Overall")),
  lapply(reps, function(r) r$contrasts_emo)
) |>
  select(Outcome, Emotion, Contrast, Parameter, Unit, Difference, CI_low, CI_high,
         Difference_pct, CI_low_pct, CI_high_pct, pd, Credible, Effect) |>
  mutate(Contrast = as.character(Contrast)) |>
  arrange(Outcome, Emotion, Contrast, Parameter)
write.csv(results_contrasts, "../data/results_contrasts.csv", row.names = FALSE)

results_means <- bind_rows(lapply(reps, function(r) cbind(Outcome = r$diag$Model, r$means)))
write.csv(results_means, "../data/results_means.csv", row.names = FALSE)

diag_all <- bind_rows(lapply(reps, `[[`, "diag"))
fa_tables(diag_all, names(diag_all), "Convergence of all models", "diag-all")
```

```{.r .cell-code}
rez_con <- results_contrasts |>
  filter(Parameter %in% c("response", "mu", "confright", "confleft", "pzero"), Unit == "%") |>
  mutate(Difference = Difference_pct, CI_low = CI_low_pct, CI_high = CI_high_pct) |>
  mutate(Effect = fct_relevel(Effect, "Negative", "n.s.", "Positive"),
         Contrast = fct_relevel(Contrast, "AI-Generated - Human Original", "Human Forgery - Human Original", "AI-Generated - Human Forgery"))

rez_con |>
  filter(Emotion == "Overall") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Difference, y = Parameter, color = Effect)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high), width = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = filter(rez_con, Emotion != "Overall"), aes(shape = Emotion), size = 2, position = position_nudge(y = 0.18)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  facet_grid(
  Contrast ~ Outcome,
  scales = "free_y",
  switch = "y"
) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Positive - High intensity" = "square plus", "Positive - Low intensity" = "square",
                                "Negative - Low intensity" = "circle", "Negative - High intensity" = "circle plus")) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Negative" = "#F44336", "n.s." = "#FF9800", "Positive" = "#4CAF50")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Effect Sizes by Contrast and Outcome",
    x = "Difference in % of the scale range (with 95% CI)",
    y = "Model Parameter"
  ) +
  theme(
  strip.placement = "outside",
  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
  strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0),
  legend.position = "bottom"
)
```

Large points with error bars are the overall contrasts, small shapes the contrasts within each stimulus emotion quadrant. Green = credibly positive, red = credibly negative, orange = CI includes 0. Gaze_Shift is omitted (no bounded scale).](3_models_files/figure-html/fig-summary-effects-1.png){#fig-summary-effects fig-alt='Grid of dot-and-whisker plots, one cell per contrast and outcome, coloured by direction and credibility of the effect.' width=1152}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
credible_main <- results_contrasts |>
  filter(Emotion == "Overall", Credible, Parameter %in% c("response", "mu") | grepl("^response", Parameter)) |>
  mutate(shown_d = ifelse(Unit == "%", Difference_pct, Difference),
         shown_lo = ifelse(Unit == "%", CI_low_pct, CI_low),
         shown_hi = ifelse(Unit == "%", CI_high_pct, CI_high),
         Diff = insight::format_value(shown_d, zap_small = TRUE),
         CI = sprintf("[%s, %s]", insight::format_value(shown_lo, zap_small = TRUE), insight::format_value(shown_hi, zap_small = TRUE)),
         pd_fmt = insight::format_pd(pd, name = NULL)) |>
  select(Outcome, Contrast, Parameter, Diff, CI, Unit, pd_fmt, Effect)

fa_tables(credible_main, names(credible_main),
          "Credible overall effects of the label on the main parameter of each model (response / mu), in % of the scale range", "summary")
```

::: {.cell}

```{.python .cell-code}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.animation as animation
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


# ─── Data from R ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_dens  = r.dens_beauty["dens"]
df_annot = r.dens_beauty["annot"]
df_par   = r.dens_beauty["par"]
df_task  = r.dftask

conditions = ["Human Original", "Human Forgery", "AI-Generated"]
colors = {
    "Human Original": "#F51D56",
    "Human Forgery":  "#F5A41D",
    "AI-Generated":   "#1D9AF5",
}

# ─── Figure — match minimal R aesthetic ───────────────────────────────────────
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8), dpi=150)
fig.patch.set_facecolor("white")
ax.set_facecolor("white")

max_y = df_dens["y"].max()

# Slider-scale band below y = 0 — tightened up vs. before.
slider_y = -max_y * 0.20     # vertical position of the slider track
pct_y    = slider_y - max_y * 0.09   # live % readout, just under the pill
anchor_y = slider_y - max_y * 0.20   # "Ugly" / "Beautiful" anchor labels
y_bottom = -max_y * 0.32             # margin below the anchor labels
ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_ylim(y_bottom, max_y * 1.55)

for spine in ["top", "right", "bottom"]:
    ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["left"].set_color("#cccccc")
ax.spines["left"].set_linewidth(0.8)
ax.spines["left"].set_bounds(0, max_y * 1.55)

ax.tick_params(length=0, labelbottom=False)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xticks([0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.0])
ax.set_ylabel("Likelihood of Response", fontsize=11, color="#333333", labelpad=8)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2, linestyle="-", color="#aaaaaa", linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

ax.hist(df_task["Beauty"].dropna(), bins=47, density=True,
        alpha=0.1, color="gray", zorder=1)

# ─── Slider track + static anchors (the handle + % readout are animated, set up below) ─
ax.plot([0, 1], [slider_y, slider_y], color="#cccccc", linewidth=3,
        solid_capstyle="round", zorder=2, clip_on=False)
ax.plot([0, 1], [slider_y, slider_y], "o", markersize=6,
        color="#bbbbbb", zorder=3, clip_on=False)
ax.text(0, anchor_y, "Ugly", ha="center", va="top",
        fontsize=10.5, color="#666666", style="italic", clip_on=False)
ax.text(1, anchor_y, "Beautiful", ha="center", va="top",
        fontsize=10.5, color="#666666", style="italic", clip_on=False)

# ─── Frame plan ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
F_LINE  = 55   # frames per density line
PAUSE   = 10   # quiet gap between phases
F_SLIDE = 40   # pointranges slide in
F_DROP  = 40   # vertical lines fall
F_DOT   = 18   # bottom dots grow in
TAIL    = 30   # hold at end

p1_end   = 3 * F_LINE                  # 165
p2_start = p1_end   + PAUSE            # 175
p2_end   = p2_start + F_SLIDE          # 215
p3_start = p2_end   + PAUSE            # 225
p3_end   = p3_start + F_DROP           # 265
p4_start = p3_end                      # 265  (dots pop as lines finish)
p4_end   = p4_start + F_DOT            # 283
N_FRAMES = p4_end   + TAIL             # 313

# Slider-handle intro: middle → wait → slow drag left → brief pause → drag
# right to settle on the Human Original mean.
HANDLE_START = 0.5
HANDLE_LEFT  = 0.15     # how far left it explores before committing
F_WAIT       = 40
F_DRAG_LEFT  = 80       # the first drag left
F_PAUSE_LEFT = 10
F_DRAG_RIGHT = 90       # On the way to the answer
h_wait_end  = F_WAIT
h_left_end  = h_wait_end  + F_DRAG_LEFT
h_pause_end = h_left_end  + F_PAUSE_LEFT
h_end       = h_pause_end + F_DRAG_RIGHT   
assert h_end <= N_FRAMES

# ─── Pre-process data per condition ───────────────────────────────────────────
dens  = {c: df_dens [df_dens ["Condition"] == c].sort_values("x").reset_index(drop=True) for c in conditions}
annot = {c: df_annot[df_annot["Condition"] == c].iloc[0]  for c in conditions}
par   = {c: df_par  [df_par  ["Condition"] == c].iloc[0]  for c in conditions}

# ─── Artists ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Phase 1: smooth density curves
dens_lines = {}
for cond in conditions:
    (l,) = ax.plot([], [], lw=2, color=colors[cond], zorder=3,
                   solid_capstyle="round", label=cond)
    dens_lines[cond] = l

# Phase 2: horizontal pointranges (line + centre dot)
pr_segs = {}
pr_dots = {}
for cond in conditions:
    (s,) = ax.plot([], [], lw=1.2, color=colors[cond], zorder=5, solid_capstyle="round")
    (d,) = ax.plot([], [], "o",    ms=0,  color=colors[cond], zorder=6)
    pr_segs[cond] = s
    pr_dots[cond] = d

# Phase 3: vertical dashed lines (left & right per condition)
vl_left  = {}
vl_right = {}
for cond in conditions:
    (ll,) = ax.plot([], [], "--", lw=0.9, color=colors[cond], alpha=0.75, zorder=4)
    (lr,) = ax.plot([], [], "--", lw=0.9, color=colors[cond], alpha=0.75, zorder=4)
    vl_left[cond]  = ll
    vl_right[cond] = lr

# Phase 4: bottom dots — clip_on=False so they're not half-swallowed by the axis
bdot_left  = {}
bdot_right = {}
for cond in conditions:
    (dl,) = ax.plot([], [], "o", color=colors[cond], zorder=7, clip_on=False)
    (dr,) = ax.plot([], [], "o", color=colors[cond], zorder=7, clip_on=False)
    bdot_left[cond]  = dl
    bdot_right[cond] = dr

ax.legend(
    handles=[dens_lines[c] for c in conditions],
    labels=conditions,
    frameon=False, loc="upper right",
    fontsize=9, title="Condition", title_fontsize=9.5,
)

handle_text = ax.text(HANDLE_START, slider_y, "Beauty", ha="center", va="center",
                       fontsize=9.5, color="white", fontweight="bold", zorder=5,
                       clip_on=False,
                       bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.55", facecolor="#555555", edgecolor="none"))
pct_text = ax.text(HANDLE_START, pct_y, "50%", ha="center", va="top",
                    fontsize=9, color="#888888", clip_on=False)

# ─── Easing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def ease_out(t: float) -> float:
    t = max(0.0, min(1.0, t))
    return 1 - (1 - t) ** 2

def ease_in_out(t: float) -> float:
    t = max(0.0, min(1.0, t))
    return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
  
# ─── Update ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def update(frame: int):

    # ── Phase 1: draw density lines one by one, left→right ────────────────────
    for i, cond in enumerate(conditions):
        fs, fe = i * F_LINE, (i + 1) * F_LINE
        d = dens[cond]
        if frame >= fe:
            dens_lines[cond].set_data(d["x"], d["y"])
        elif frame >= fs:
            t = ease_out((frame - fs) / F_LINE)
            n = max(1, int(t * len(d)))
            dens_lines[cond].set_data(d["x"].iloc[:n], d["y"].iloc[:n])

    # ── Phase 2: all three pointranges slide in from the left simultaneously ───
    if frame >= p2_start:
        t = ease_out((frame - p2_start) / F_SLIDE)
        for cond in conditions:
            p = par[cond]
            low, high, mean, y_pr = p["Mean_low"], p["Mean_high"], p["Mean"], p["Mean_y"]
            cur_hi = low + t * (high - low)
            pr_segs[cond].set_data([low, cur_hi], [y_pr, y_pr])
            # Centre dot appears once the sliding front reaches the mean position
            frac = (mean - low) / max(high - low, 1e-9)
            if t >= frac:
                dot_t = ease_out((t - frac) / max(1.0 - frac, 1e-9))
                pr_dots[cond].set_data([mean], [y_pr])
                pr_dots[cond].set_markersize(5.5 * dot_t)
            else:
                pr_dots[cond].set_data([], [])

    # ── Phase 3: vertical lines fall downward from the density peak ────────────
    # Top stays pinned at the curve; bottom drops from peak → 0
    if frame >= p3_start:
        t = ease_out((frame - p3_start) / F_DROP)
        for cond in conditions:
            a = annot[cond]
            bot_r = a["right_y"] * (1 - t)   # bottom falls from right_y to 0
            bot_l = a["left_y"]  * (1 - t)
            vl_right[cond].set_data([a["right_x"], a["right_x"]], [bot_r, a["right_y"]])
            vl_left[cond].set_data( [a["left_x"],  a["left_x"] ], [bot_l, a["left_y"] ])

    # ── Phase 4: bottom dots grow in at y = 0 ─────────────────────────────────
    # Sizes mirror R's geom_point(aes(size = right_size * 6)) with scale_size_identity()
    # ggplot size in mm → matplotlib markersize in pts: × 2.835
    if frame >= p4_start:
        t = ease_out((frame - p4_start) / F_DOT)
        for cond in conditions:
            a = annot[cond]
            ms_r = a["right_size"] * 6 * 2.835 * t
            ms_l = a["left_size"]  * 6 * 2.835 * t
            bdot_right[cond].set_data([a["right_x"]], [0])
            bdot_right[cond].set_markersize(max(0.1, ms_r))
            bdot_left[cond].set_data( [a["left_x"]],  [0])
            bdot_left[cond].set_markersize(max(0.1, ms_l))
            
    # ── Slider handle: middle → wait → drag left → drag right to the mean ─────
    target_x = par["Human Original"]["Mean"]
    if frame <= h_wait_end:
        x = HANDLE_START
    elif frame <= h_left_end:
        t = ease_in_out((frame - h_wait_end) / F_DRAG_LEFT)
        x = HANDLE_START + t * (HANDLE_LEFT - HANDLE_START)
    elif frame <= h_pause_end:
        x = HANDLE_LEFT
    elif frame <= h_end:
        t = ease_in_out((frame - h_pause_end) / F_DRAG_RIGHT)
        x = HANDLE_LEFT + t * (target_x - HANDLE_LEFT)
    else:
        x = target_x

    handle_text.set_x(x)
    pct_text.set_x(x)
    pct_text.set_text(f"{x * 100:.0f}%")

    return (
        list(dens_lines.values())
        + list(pr_segs.values())
        + list(pr_dots.values())
        + list(vl_left.values())
        + list(vl_right.values())
        + list(bdot_left.values())
        + list(bdot_right.values())
        + [handle_text, pct_text]
    )

# ─── Build & save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ani = animation.FuncAnimation(
    fig, update,
    frames=N_FRAMES,
    interval=40,
    blit=False,   # False is safer with clip_on=False artists
    repeat=False,
)

ani.save("figures/anim_beauty.gif", writer="pillow", fps=30, dpi=150)
plt.close()
print("✓ Saved distribution_animation.gif")
```

### Beauty by Emotion



::: {.cell}

```{.python .cell-code}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Polygon
from matplotlib.colors import to_rgb
from PIL import Image
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# ─── Data from R ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_dens_neutral  = r.dens_beauty["dens"]
df_annot_neutral = r.dens_beauty["annot"]
df_par_neutral   = r.dens_beauty["par"]

df_dens_emo  = r.dens_beauty_condemo["dens"]
df_annot_emo = r.dens_beauty_condemo["annot"]
df_par_emo   = r.dens_beauty_condemo["par"]

df_task = r.dftask

conditions = ["Human Original", "Human Forgery", "AI-Generated"]
colors = {
    "Human Original": "#F51D56",
    "Human Forgery":  "#F5A41D",
    "AI-Generated":   "#1D9AF5",
}

# ─── Cycle order (loops back to Neutral) ──────────────────────────────────────
state_order = [
    "Neutral",
    "Positive - High intensity",
    "Positive - Low intensity",
    "Negative - Low intensity",
    "Negative - High intensity",
]
N_STATES = len(state_order)

quadrant_coords = {
    "Neutral":                    (0.0,   0.0),
    "Positive - High intensity":  (0.65,  0.65),
    "Positive - Low intensity":   (0.65, -0.65),
    "Negative - Low intensity":   (-0.65, -0.65),
    "Negative - High intensity":  (-0.65,  0.65),
}

quad_colors = {
    "Neutral":                    "#1a1a1a",
    "Positive - High intensity":  "#2E9E4F",
    "Positive - Low intensity":   "#2E9E4F",
    "Negative - Low intensity":   "#D1453D",
    "Negative - High intensity":  "#D1453D",
}

# ─── Build per-state, per-condition lookups ───────────────────────────────────
def build_state_dict(dens_df, annot_df, par_df, emotion=None):
    out = {}
    for cond in conditions:
        if emotion is None:
            d = dens_df[dens_df["Condition"] == cond].sort_values("x").reset_index(drop=True)
            a = annot_df[annot_df["Condition"] == cond].iloc[0]
            p = par_df[par_df["Condition"] == cond].iloc[0]
        else:
            d = dens_df[(dens_df["Condition"] == cond) & (dens_df["Emotion"] == emotion)] \
                    .sort_values("x").reset_index(drop=True)
            a = annot_df[(annot_df["Condition"] == cond) & (annot_df["Emotion"] == emotion)].iloc[0]
            p = par_df[(par_df["Condition"] == cond) & (par_df["Emotion"] == emotion)].iloc[0]
        out[cond] = {"x": d["x"].to_numpy(), "y": d["y"].to_numpy(), "annot": a, "par": p}
    return out

states = {"Neutral": build_state_dict(df_dens_neutral, df_annot_neutral, df_par_neutral, emotion=None)}
for emo in state_order[1:]:
    states[emo] = build_state_dict(df_dens_emo, df_annot_emo, df_par_emo, emotion=emo)

# ─── Global axis scaling ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
max_y = max(df_dens_neutral["y"].max(), df_dens_emo["y"].max())
all_par = pd.concat([df_par_neutral, df_par_emo], ignore_index=True, sort=False)
y_top = max(max_y * 1.35, all_par["Mean_y"].max() * 1.15)
y_bottom = -max_y * 0.12

# ─── Figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 8), dpi=150)
fig.patch.set_facecolor("white")
ax.set_facecolor("white")

# reserve headroom above the axes so the raised legend/quadrant never clip
fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.97, bottom=0.10, left=0.07, right=0.95)

ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_ylim(y_bottom, y_top)
for spine in ["top", "right", "bottom"]:
    ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["left"].set_color("#cccccc")
ax.spines["left"].set_linewidth(0.8)
ax.spines["left"].set_bounds(0, y_top)
ax.tick_params(length=0, labelbottom=True)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xticks([0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.0])
ax.set_xticklabels(["0%\nUgly", "25%", "50%", "75%", "100%\nBeautiful"], fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_ylabel("Likelihood of Response", fontsize=11, color="#333333", labelpad=8, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel("Beauty Rating", fontsize=11, color="#333333", labelpad=10, fontweight='bold')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2, linestyle="-", color="#aaaaaa", linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

if "Beauty" in df_task.columns:
    ax.hist(df_task["Beauty"].dropna(), bins=47, density=True,
            alpha=0.1, color="gray", zorder=1)

# ─── Artists: density curves, pointranges, vertical lines, bottom dots ────────
dens_lines, pr_segs, pr_dots = {}, {}, {}
vl_left, vl_right, bdot_left, bdot_right = {}, {}, {}, {}
for cond in conditions:
    (l,)  = ax.plot([], [], lw=2, color=colors[cond], zorder=3, solid_capstyle="round", label=cond)
    (s,)  = ax.plot([], [], lw=1.2, color=colors[cond], zorder=5, solid_capstyle="round")
    (d,)  = ax.plot([], [], "o", ms=5.5, color=colors[cond], zorder=6)
    (ll,) = ax.plot([], [], "--", lw=0.9, color=colors[cond], alpha=0.75, zorder=4)
    (lr,) = ax.plot([], [], "--", lw=0.9, color=colors[cond], alpha=0.75, zorder=4)
    (dl,) = ax.plot([], [], "o", color=colors[cond], zorder=7, clip_on=False)
    (dr,) = ax.plot([], [], "o", color=colors[cond], zorder=7, clip_on=False)
    dens_lines[cond] = l
    pr_segs[cond]    = s
    pr_dots[cond]    = d
    vl_left[cond]    = ll
    vl_right[cond]   = lr
    bdot_left[cond]  = dl
    bdot_right[cond] = dr

leg = ax.legend(
    handles=[dens_lines[c] for c in conditions], labels=conditions,
    frameon=False, loc="upper right", bbox_to_anchor=(0.995, 0.9),
    fontsize=9, title="Condition", title_fontsize=9.5,
)
leg.get_title().set_fontweight("bold")
leg.get_title().set_color("#333333")

# ─── Valence × Intensity quadrant inset ───────────────────────────────────────
QUAD_SIZE = 0.33
ax_quad = ax.inset_axes([-0.04, 0.86 - QUAD_SIZE, QUAD_SIZE, QUAD_SIZE])
ax_quad.set_xlim(-1.6, 1.6)
ax_quad.set_ylim(-1.6, 1.6)
ax_quad.set_aspect("equal")
ax_quad.set_facecolor("white")
ax_quad.patch.set_alpha(0.85)
for spine in ax_quad.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)
ax_quad.set_xticks([])
ax_quad.set_yticks([])

ax_quad.set_title("Emotion", fontsize=9.5, fontweight="bold", color="#333333", pad=6)

ax_quad.annotate("", xy=(1.3, 0), xytext=(-1.3, 0),
                  arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color="#cccccc", lw=0.8,
                                   shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0))
ax_quad.annotate("", xy=(0, 1.3), xytext=(0, -1.3),
                  arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color="#cccccc", lw=0.8,
                                   shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0))

ax_quad.text(-1.4, 0.12, "Negative", ha="left", va="bottom", fontsize=7.6, color="#888888")
ax_quad.text(1.4, 0.12, "Positive", ha="right", va="bottom", fontsize=7.6, color="#888888")
ax_quad.text(0.12, 1.32, "High", ha="left", va="center", fontsize=7.6, color="#888888")
ax_quad.text(0.12, -1.32, "Low", ha="left", va="center", fontsize=7.6, color="#888888")

def star_vertices(cx, cy, outer_r, spikiness, n_points=5, rotation=np.pi / 2):
    spikiness = np.clip(spikiness, 0.0, 1.0)
    inner_r = outer_r * (1 - spikiness * 0.62)
    n = n_points * 2
    angles = rotation + np.arange(n) * (2 * np.pi / n)
    radii = np.where(np.arange(n) % 2 == 0, outer_r, inner_r)
    return np.column_stack([cx + radii * np.cos(angles), cy + radii * np.sin(angles)])

quad_dot = Polygon(star_vertices(0, 0, 0.20, 0.0), closed=True,
                    facecolor=quad_colors["Neutral"], edgecolor="white",
                    linewidth=0.7, zorder=6)
ax_quad.add_patch(quad_dot)

# ─── Easing / interpolation helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────
def ease_in_out(t: float) -> float:
    t = max(0.0, min(1.0, t))
    return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)

def lerp(a, b, t):
    return a + t * (b - a)

def lerp_color(c0, c1, t):
    rgb0, rgb1 = np.array(to_rgb(c0)), np.array(to_rgb(c1))
    return tuple(lerp(rgb0, rgb1, t))

# ─── Frame plan ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
F_HOLD  = 45
F_TRANS = 55
SEG = F_HOLD + F_TRANS
N_FRAMES = N_STATES * SEG  # last morph lands back on Neutral -> seamless loop

# ─── Update (mutates all artists for a given frame) ───────────────────────────
def update(frame: int):
    s = frame // SEG
    local = frame % SEG
    cur_state = state_order[s]
    nxt_state = state_order[(s + 1) % N_STATES]
    t = 0.0 if local < F_HOLD else ease_in_out((local - F_HOLD) / F_TRANS)

    cur = states[cur_state]
    nxt = states[nxt_state]

    for cond in conditions:
        c0, c1 = cur[cond], nxt[cond]
        y = lerp(c0["y"], c1["y"], t)
        dens_lines[cond].set_data(c0["x"], y)

        a0, a1 = c0["annot"], c1["annot"]
        p0, p1 = c0["par"], c1["par"]

        rx = lerp(a0["right_x"], a1["right_x"], t)
        ry = lerp(a0["right_y"], a1["right_y"], t)
        lx = lerp(a0["left_x"],  a1["left_x"],  t)
        ly = lerp(a0["left_y"],  a1["left_y"],  t)
        r_size = lerp(a0["right_size"], a1["right_size"], t)
        l_size = lerp(a0["left_size"],  a1["left_size"],  t)

        vl_right[cond].set_data([rx, rx], [0, ry])
        vl_left[cond].set_data([lx, lx], [0, ly])
        bdot_right[cond].set_data([rx], [0])
        bdot_right[cond].set_markersize(max(0.1, r_size * 6 * 2.835))
        bdot_left[cond].set_data([lx], [0])
        bdot_left[cond].set_markersize(max(0.1, l_size * 6 * 2.835))

        mean   = lerp(p0["Mean"], p1["Mean"], t)
        m_low  = lerp(p0["Mean_low"], p1["Mean_low"], t)
        m_high = lerp(p0["Mean_high"], p1["Mean_high"], t)
        m_y    = lerp(p0["Mean_y"], p1["Mean_y"], t)

        pr_segs[cond].set_data([m_low, m_high], [m_y, m_y])
        pr_dots[cond].set_data([mean], [m_y])

    qx0, qy0 = quadrant_coords[cur_state]
    qx1, qy1 = quadrant_coords[nxt_state]
    qx, qy = lerp(qx0, qx1, t), lerp(qy0, qy1, t)

    col = lerp_color(quad_colors[cur_state], quad_colors[nxt_state], t)
    spikiness = np.clip(qy / 0.65, 0.0, 1.0)
    quad_dot.set_xy(star_vertices(qx, qy, 0.20, spikiness))
    quad_dot.set_facecolor(col)

# Manual render loop with a fixed global GIF palette 
def render_frame_image():
    fig.canvas.draw()
    buf = np.asarray(fig.canvas.buffer_rgba())
    return Image.fromarray(buf).convert("RGB")

# Sample a handful of frames spanning every hold + transition, so the shared
# palette actually contains black, green, red, and the in-between hues.
calibration_frames = sorted(set(
    [0, N_FRAMES - 1] +
    [i * SEG for i in range(N_STATES)] +
    [i * SEG + F_HOLD // 2 for i in range(N_STATES)] +
    [i * SEG + F_HOLD + F_TRANS // 2 for i in range(N_STATES)]
))
calib_imgs = []
for f in calibration_frames:
    update(f)
    calib_imgs.append(render_frame_image())

calib_strip = Image.new("RGB", (calib_imgs[0].width, calib_imgs[0].height * len(calib_imgs)))
for i, im_ in enumerate(calib_imgs):
    calib_strip.paste(im_, (0, i * im_.height))
base_palette_img = calib_strip.quantize(colors=256, method=Image.MEDIANCUT)

# Now render every real frame and quantize it against that ONE shared palette.
# dither=Image.NONE keeps flat color regions (backgrounds, lines) perfectly
# stable frame-to-frame -- this is what actually removes the flicker.
quantized_frames = []
for frame in range(N_FRAMES):
    update(frame)
    img = render_frame_image()
    quantized_frames.append(img.quantize(palette=base_palette_img, dither=Image.NONE))

# NOTE: do NOT pass optimize=True below -- it can silently re-quantize frames
# per-frame and reintroduce the exact flicker we just fixed.
quantized_frames[0].save(
    "figures/anim_beauty_emotion.gif",
    save_all=True,
    append_images=quantized_frames[1:],
    duration=33,   # ~30fps
    loop=0,
    disposal=2,
)
plt.close()
print("✓ Saved anim_beauty_emotion.gif")
```
